allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat(game): implement initial Hole.io-style browser game

- Set up Vite + TypeScript project with Three.js and Cannon.js physics
- Implement FSD architecture (app, entities, features, shared)
- Create movable hole with WASD/arrow controls and camera following
- Add 5 boxes (cubes/parallelepipeds) and 10 pyramids as consumable objects
- Implement basic collision detection and scoring system
- Add spatial partitioning with Quadtree for performance
- Include implementation plan documentation

Note: Physics tipping behavior for realistic object consumption is not yet implemented. Objects currently use simplified falling mechanics.
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "fix(physics): implement moving ground with square hole for tipping mechanics

- Replace segmented radial ground with 4-box square hole approach
- Move entire ground body position instead of rebuilding segments
- Only rebuild ground when hole grows, not on every movement
- Remove all artificial torque and force application
- Objects now tip naturally when over hole edge based on physics
- Eliminate object disturbance from frequent ground rebuilds")
